summary: Variants should separate orchestration, evidence production, verdict review and periodic recalibration.

items.text: Run gates as an explicit pipeline with fan-out for independent checks and a deterministic join policy.
Normalize every gate into one result packet containing status, evidence, uncertainty and remediation.
Require executable tests, analyzers or reproduction steps for claims that can block integration.
Re-run gate standards over the whole system on a schedule to detect policy and baseline drift.
